example.title: St. John Chrysostom Church, Church Street
example.source: HABS WI-162 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,67-DELA,2-)

brief: Small Episcopal church of 1856 attributed to Richard Upjohn: a steep-roofed nave clad in vertical board-and-batten with a pointed-arch entrance and pointed lancet windows, a cross on the front gable, and a separate open wooden bell tower on a battered board-and-batten base standing in the churchyard under large oaks.
